notes: Timing is a declared scenario window shaped like a monsoon flood event, not a reconstructed hydrograph.
No rainfall, river-stage or depth measurement passed the project licence gate, so depth is a distance-to-water scenario decay.
GISTDA open-data host did not resolve from the build environment, so no observed extent layer exists in this run.
Destinations are hypothetical model targets, not verified shelters. No refuge inventory exists in this build.
Warning reach, compliance and preparation delay are uncalibrated priors and must be treated as sensitivity parameters.
Reduced-mobility agents are assumed to walk at the standard pedestrian speed; no assistance-need routing is implemented.

baseline_comparison.description: A dry run with the flood scenario disabled, used to isolate the flood effect on clearance time.

warnings: No destination in this run is a verified refuge.
Clearance times depend on uncalibrated behavioural priors and must not be read as predictions.
The flood depth surface is a scenario, not a hydraulic simulation or an observation.
